item.title: A large bough has fallen from a tree on the highway verge, 26th October
item.description:
Tree located on verge of Ermin Street and has fallen into the rear garden of 99 Moorfield Road, destroying a fence panel and damaging the remaining fence. It fell overnight on Saturday and was reported by the neighbouring houses via this portal. The reports were forwarded to Tewkesbury Borough Council, but they have responded today saying it is not their issue and to contact GCC.
